brands.name: Michael Miller Surfboards
brands.short_description: San Diego hand-shaped surfboards by Michael Miller — Simmons-inspired gliders, traditional fishes, and custom shortboards from 1165 Cushman Ave.

models.name: Drifter
models.description: Michael Miller's version of Skip's Fish Simmons with a single to deep double concave exiting the tail and fair V in the tail. Tail block stays at 10" across sizes from 5'6" up to almost 12' for smooth gliding trim.

models.name: Fish
models.description: Traditional style fish with a single concave and a 12" tail-block.

models.name: Quad Fish
models.description: Quad fish with double wing pulling in the tail and a single concave bottom.

models.name: Nozzle Fish
models.description: Nozzle style fish with a single concave, no beak on smaller versions, wider overall than the traditional fish, and added curve in the tail bringing the tail block to about 11".

models.name: Eagle
models.description: Single to double concave with vee — available from 8' through 12' in Michael Miller's San Diego shaping bay.
